name: pta-mumbai
description: PTA Mumbai website – React (Vite) frontend + Node.js (Express) backend

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,blue "node --watch --env-file-if-exists=server/.env server/index.js" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
